Hi Priya, AWS team —

Thanks for agreeing to collaborate on the CloudBridge listing. To keep the launch on a predictable timeline and make sure we have clear owners, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that lays out evaluation checkpoints, compliance requirements, and a close/window-to-launch estimate. High-level asks:

- Can CloudBridge confirm the technical owner for listing artifacts (screenshots, logos, AMI/container) and expected delivery date?
- AWS Marketplace Ops — can you confirm the required artifact checklist and whether there are any additional sandbox/test account steps for a private preview?
- Internal owners: Marissa will lead the go-to-market assets, Jasmine will own the integration testing plan, Laura will coordinate legal/compliance artifacts.

Proposed timeline (editable in the attached MAP):
- Week 0 (today): kickoff + roles confirmed
- Week 1: artifact delivery (screenshots, pricing, support contact)
- Week 2: internal integration testing + AWS artifact validation
- Week 3: listing submission + legal sign-off
- Week 5: target public listing (conditional on AWS review)

Attachments: MAP-CloudBridge-AWS-v1.xlsx (MAP with owners + milestones), listing-artifacts-checklist.pdf, redwood-marketplace-terms-draft.docx

Please reply with owners and any adjusted dates no later than EOD Wednesday so we can lock the first sprint. I’ll schedule a 30-minute working session tomorrow to triage blockers.

Thanks —

Hi all,

Thanks for the invite. For Marketplace intake we typically need:
- Product artifacts: screenshots (1200x800), product description, pricing details, and a support contact.
- Technical artifacts: AMI/container image URI, runbook for onboarding, and an integration test plan.
- Compliance: any SOC/Security attestations (if not public, provide point of contact).

Sandbox/testing: we can provide a Private Test Account (PTA) for CloudBridge. To provision PTA we need an admin email and expected usage window. Please send the admin email to this alias; allow 2 business days for provisioning.

Tentative review cadence: submission -> 3 business days intake check -> 5–7 business days technical validation -> listing approval window.

We attached a canonical checklist (attached here) and a contact for the operations engineer (megan_ops@amazonaws.com).

Best,
AWS Marketplace Ops Team
aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
